findings.title: Unauthenticated server-side request forgery via /api/download-url
findings.proof: baseline: anonymous GET /api/status last_error='' and /games lists 7 games with no probe artifact; attack: anonymous POST /api/download-url with JSON url=http://127.0.0.1:1/probe and game=probe -> HTTP 202; source webxfer.cpp:1893-1895 accepts any http(s) URL with no host allowlist and 1918-1921 passes it to HttpClient.GetAsync; diff: after 6s last_error='URL download failed' proving the console itself attempted the arbitrary URL; /games still 7 entries, no file written; 127.0.0.1:9127 returned 'URL download HTTP 404' confirming loopback reachability is measurable
